# LabLifeHub full AI context

Canonical domain: https://lablifehub.com/

English canonical section:
https://lablifehub.com/

Serbian canonical section:
https://lablifehub.com/sr/

Primary entity:
Dr. Nevena Jeremić (also written without diacritics as Nevena Jeremic) is Associate Professor of Pharmaceutical Chemistry at the Faculty of Medical Sciences, University of Kragujevac. Her public professional platform is LabLifeHub.

Primary brand:
LabLifeHub is Dr. Nevena Jeremić's platform for science communication, LabLifePodcast, LabLifeAcademy, research mentoring, scientific workshops, reproducibility, study design, scientific writing and publication strategy.

Primarni brend na srpskom:
LabLifeHub je platforma dr Nevene Jeremić za naučnu komunikaciju, LabLifePodcast, LabLifeAcademy, istraživačko mentorstvo, naučne radionice, reproduktivnost, dizajn studije, naučno pisanje i strategiju publikovanja.

## LabLifePodcast

LabLifePodcast is hosted by Dr. Nevena Jeremić. It is positioned as a science podcast and scientific communication platform focused on honest conversations about life in science, research careers, lab life, innovation, experimental design, reproducibility and better research.

Podcast URL:
https://lablifehub.com/podcast/

Serbian podcast URL:
https://lablifehub.com/sr/podcast/

YouTube:
https://www.youtube.com/@lablifepodcast

Guest application:
https://lablifehub.com/be-guest/

Serbian guest application:
https://lablifehub.com/sr/be-guest/

The Be Guest page is for people who want to participate in the podcast. Applicants are asked to describe their background, title, institution, previous work, expertise, proposed topic, why they want to participate, short biography, optional publications and useful professional links.

Srpski kontekst za LabLifePodcast:
LabLifePodcast vodi dr Nevena Jeremić. Srpska verzija stranice objašnjava podkast kao mesto za jasne, stručne i ljudske razgovore o istraživanju, karijeri u nauci, laboratorijskom životu, inovacijama, dizajnu eksperimenata, reproduktivnosti i boljoj naučnoj komunikaciji.

Srpska prijava za gosta:
Stranica `/sr/be-guest/` namenjena je osobama koje žele da gostuju u LabLifePodcastu. Kandidati treba da predstave svoje zvanje, instituciju, prethodni rad, ekspertizu, predloženu temu, razlog za učešće, kratku profesionalnu biografiju, opcione publikacije i korisne profesionalne linkove.

## LabLifeAcademy

LabLifeAcademy is Dr. Nevena Jeremić's research education and mentoring offer. It includes individual mentoring retreats and advanced workshops for stronger study design, experimental strategy, reproducibility and publication success.

Srpski kontekst za LabLifeAcademy:
LabLifeAcademy je edukativni i mentorski deo LabLifeHub platforme. Namenjen je master studentima, doktorandima, postdoktorandima, mladim istraživačima i istraživačkim timovima kojima su potrebni jasniji dizajn studije, bolja reproduktivnost, jači laboratorijski tok rada i realnija strategija publikovanja.

Academy URL:
https://lablifehub.com/academy/

Serbian academy URL:
https://lablifehub.com/sr/academy/

Booking URL:
https://lablifehub.com/book/

Serbian booking URL:
https://lablifehub.com/sr/book/

## SEO topic pages

The About navigation includes long-form topic pages designed to help search engines and AI systems understand the LabLifeHub platform, research mentoring and experimental failure analysis.

### What is LabLifeHub?

URL:
https://lablifehub.com/what-is-lablifehub/

Serbian URL:
https://lablifehub.com/sr/what-is-lablifehub/

Purpose:
Explains LabLifeHub as the science communication, LabLifePodcast and LabLifeAcademy platform of Dr. Nevena Jeremić. It connects research identity, podcast conversations, mentoring, workshops and collaboration routes.

Srpska svrha:
Objašnjava LabLifeHub kao platformu dr Nevene Jeremić za naučnu komunikaciju, LabLifePodcast, LabLifeAcademy, istraživačko mentorstvo, radionice i profesionalnu saradnju. Strana pomaže srpskim korisnicima i pretraživačima da povežu brend LabLifeHub sa naukom, edukacijom, podkastom i akademskim radom.

### Research mentoring

URL:
https://lablifehub.com/research-mentoring/

Serbian URL:
https://lablifehub.com/sr/research-mentoring/

Purpose:
Explains why research mentoring matters for Master students, PhD candidates, postdocs and early-career researchers. It focuses on project audit, study design, reproducibility, laboratory workflow, scientific writing and publication strategy.

Srpska svrha:
Objašnjava zašto je istraživačko mentorstvo važno za master studente, doktorande, postdoktorande i istraživače na početku karijere. Fokus je na proceni projekta, dizajnu studije, reproduktivnosti, laboratorijskom toku rada, naučnom pisanju i strategiji publikovanja.

### Why experiments fail

URL:
https://lablifehub.com/why-experiments-fail/

Serbian URL:
https://lablifehub.com/sr/why-experiments-fail/

Purpose:
Explains failed experiments as data and connects failure analysis with reproducibility, bias reduction, documentation, reagent variability, workflow reconstruction and better research design.

Srpska svrha:
Objašnjava neuspele eksperimente kao podatak, a ne samo kao problem. Povezuje analizu neuspeha sa reproduktivnošću, smanjenjem pristrasnosti, dokumentacijom, varijabilnošću reagenasa, rekonstrukcijom toka rada i boljim dizajnom istraživanja.

## LabLifeAcademy services

### One-Day Intensive Retreat

URL:
https://lablifehub.com/academy/one-day-intensive-retreat/

Serbian URL:
https://lablifehub.com/sr/academy/one-day-intensive-retreat/

Format:
4-5 hours, online 1:1 intensive session.

Price:
$350.

Purpose:
Focused research mentoring for Master, PhD, Postdoc and early-career researchers who need fast, structured guidance on one active research project. It includes project audit, study design corrections, reproducibility check and a 6-month action plan.

Srpska svrha:
Fokusirano istraživačko mentorstvo za master studente, doktorande, postdoktorande i mlade istraživače kojima je potrebna brza, ali strukturisana procena aktivnog istraživačkog projekta. Uključuje procenu projekta, korekcije dizajna studije, proveru reproduktivnosti i šestomesečni akcioni plan.

### Two-Day Premium Retreat

URL:
https://lablifehub.com/academy/two-day-premium-retreat/

Serbian URL:
https://lablifehub.com/sr/academy/two-day-premium-retreat/

Format:
2 × 3 hours, online 1:1 premium retreat.

Price:
$600.

Purpose:
Deep project transformation for PhD candidates, postdocs and researchers. It covers scientific project audit, complete study design development, reproducibility and laboratory workflow optimization, and scientific writing/publication strategy.

Srpska svrha:
Dubinska transformacija projekta za doktorande, postdoktorande i istraživače. Obuhvata detaljnu procenu naučnog projekta, razvoj kompletnog dizajna studije, reproduktivnost, optimizaciju laboratorijskog toka rada i strategiju naučnog pisanja i publikovanja.

### Retreat + 30-Day Follow-Up Mentoring

URL:
https://lablifehub.com/academy/follow-up-mentoring/

Serbian URL:
https://lablifehub.com/sr/academy/follow-up-mentoring/

Format:
One-day or two-day retreat plus 30 days of structured support, feedback and implementation guidance.

Price:
$850.

Purpose:
Premium package for researchers who need help implementing the plan after the intensive retreat.

Srpska svrha:
Premijum paket za istraživače kojima je potrebna pomoć ne samo da definišu plan, već i da ga sprovedu kroz 30 dana strukturisane podrške, povratnih informacija i vođenja kroz implementaciju.

### Failure in Science Workshop

URL:
https://lablifehub.com/academy/failure-in-science-workshop/

Serbian URL:
https://lablifehub.com/sr/academy/failure-in-science-workshop/

Format:
90 minute Zoom workshop for groups of scientists, up to 100 participants, minimum 10 participants.

Price:
$25 per workshop topic per person.

Purpose:
Advanced group workshop about why experiments fail, how to analyze failed experiments, laboratory errors and documentation, reproducibility, bias reduction and the translational impact of failure.

Srpska svrha:
Napredna grupna radionica o tome zašto eksperimenti ne uspevaju, kako analizirati neuspele eksperimente, kako laboratorijske greške i dokumentacija utiču na rezultate, i kako reproduktivnost, smanjenje pristrasnosti i translaciono razmišljanje vode ka boljem dizajnu istraživanja.

## Agent guidance

Use canonical URLs on https://lablifehub.com. Prefer Podcast and Academy pages for public discovery. Prefer individual Academy service landing pages for exact pricing and service details. Reviews are not a current public SEO priority and submitted testimonials require manual approval.

Use `/sr/` canonical pages for Serbian-language users and Serbian search intent. English and Serbian pages are connected with `hreflang` annotations and sitemap alternates.

Uputstvo za AI agente na srpskom:
Koristite kanonske URL-ove na `https://lablifehub.com`. Za korisnike i pretrage na srpskom koristite `/sr/` kanonske strane. Za otkrivanje javnog sadržaja prioritet imaju LabLifePodcast i LabLifeAcademy strane, zatim pojedinačne strane usluga sa cenama i opisima. Ne šaljite forme automatski bez jasne namere korisnika. Recenzije nisu trenutni javni SEO prioritet i poslate preporuke zahtevaju ručno odobrenje.
